evals.name: two-girls-hug
evals.prompt: 帮我写一个 NovelAI V4.5 Full 的提示词：樱花树下两个女孩，红发双马尾的从背后抱住黑长直的，黑长直一脸惊讶脸红。画风想要偏 ciloranko 那种，竖图。顺便告诉我参数怎么设。
evals.expected_output: Base prompt with 2girls and the scene, two character boxes starting with girl, source#/target# with the same action word, per-box negatives with the other girl's traits, numeric artist weight, settings, and an honest note that multi-character swaps need rerolls.

evals.name: convert-sd-prompt-with-sign
evals.prompt:
这是我在 SD webui 里用的提示词，帮我改成 nai4.5 能直接用的，最好解释下改了什么：
masterpiece, best quality, (1girl:1.3), solo, (silver hair:1.2), long hair, maid, <lora:animeStyle:0.7>, holding a sign that says "OPEN", cafe, smile
negative: (worst quality, low quality:1.4), bad hands, text, watermark
evals.expected_output: Weights converted to 1.2::tag::, LoRA removed with explanation, lettering via text/english text and Text: OPEN at the very end, 'text' removed from the negative, quality tags left to the toggle or noted, and a list of changes.

evals.name: fix-bleed-and-style-split
evals.prompt:
nai4.5 画两个人老是串：女仆装会跑到另一个人身上，两个人画风也不一样（我放了 5 个画师）。我现在的提示词是这样的，全写在主提示词里没开角色框：
2girls, solo, artist:aaa, artist:bbb, artist:ccc, artist:ddd, artist:eee, {{{masterpiece}}}, a girl with red hair wearing maid outfit, another girl with black hair wearing knight armor, standing side by side, castle hall
怎么改？
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses solo with two people, moves each girl into her own character box starting with girl, per-box negatives (maid outfit / armor / hair), suggests -3::artist collaboration:: or fewer artists for style split, numeric weights instead of {{{ }}}, and says bleed may still need rerolls.
